items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: And what's the matter with big Jim Robinson?

ctx.x: Well, Louis Armstrong's neck comes out so far and George Brunus' whole face comes out.
And what's the matter with big Jim Robinson? Yeah, he comes out. He's got two pouches on the side of his face that come out.
I think George's face swells out more as the whole face in there. And Louis' neck comes out. Other people's neck, too, have seen it.
